entries.title: Storyline: Alone, but not lost
entries.summary: One road, seven turns: engineer at NIE Mysore, first contact at URS Cars, the COVID pause, the Triton shop floor, the pivot through RIMS/KPMG/Pepino, the engine at Digital Maven, and the next branch into data science.
entries.details: Lessons along the way: find the mechanism, not the symptom; the problem is whatever the customer feels it is; data only matters when someone acts on it; understand the workflow before designing the solution; a model is only useful when it changes a real decision.
